label: Tutorial: Bundle
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Bundle page (endpoint bundle.detail). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: A bundle
steps.text: Rules of any format gathered around one subject. This tour goes through its actions and every tab.

steps.title: What the bundle is for
steps.text: Its description, written by its author.

steps.title: At a glance
steps.text: Number of rules, formats, votes and downloads.

steps.title: Vote
steps.text: Like or dislike the bundle. Hover the numbers to see who voted.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: **Everything** (README, description, tags and every file), the **structure** (its folders as a zip) or just the **rules** with their JSON metadata.

steps.title: Share
steps.text: A private link: whoever has it can see the bundle even when it is private.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: Change its name, description, visibility, rules and folders — its owner and admins only.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: Something wrong with this bundle? Tell the administrators.

steps.title: Tags
steps.text: Tags of the bundle; click one to find the other bundles and rules with it.

steps.title: Inside the bundle
steps.text: Each tab shows one side of the bundle.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: The bundle's folders and files, as a tree — the layout you get in the zip.

steps.title: Rules
steps.text: Every rule of the bundle, with the usual search and filters.

steps.title: Files & documents
steps.text: Notes, reports and other non-rule files of the bundle.

steps.title: ATT&CK coverage
steps.text: Which techniques the bundle's rules detect, on the ATT&CK matrix.

steps.title: Releases
steps.text: Frozen versions of the bundle: what was deployed, exactly, at a given date.

steps.title: Health
steps.text: Checks before deploying: rules that fail to compile, duplicates, missing dependencies…

steps.title: Notes
steps.text: Known issues and remarks from the community about the bundle.

steps.title: AI analysis
steps.text: Rulezy's review of the whole bundle: coverage, gaps, suggestions.

steps.title: History
steps.text: Every change made to the bundle.

steps.title: MISP event
steps.text: The bundle as a MISP event, ready to push to a connected MISP instance.

steps.title: Discussion
steps.text: Comments on the bundle.
